name: beforeAfter
title: Before After
description: Clear transformation or contrast between two states, especially symbolic or visual before/after: manual to automated, chaos to order, old way to new way.

vanillasky.useWhen: Clear transformation or contrast between two states, especially symbolic or visual before/after: manual to automated, chaos to order, old way to new way.

problemLabel.label: Before label
problemLabel.description: Uppercase pill label shown above the before headline.

problemHeadline.label: Before headline
problemHeadline.description: Headline shown during the before phase. 2-5 words. Sits centered, beneath the BEFORE pill.

solutionLabel.label: After label
solutionLabel.description: Uppercase pill label shown above the after headline.

solutionHeadline.label: After headline
solutionHeadline.description: Headline shown during the after phase. 2-5 words. Sits centered, beneath the AFTER pill.

problemEmojis.label: Before emojis
problemEmojis.description: JSON array of emojis for the chaos / before state (5-8 types, cycled to fill 16 slots distributed around the central text). Example: ["📅", "😰", "💼", "📊", "⏰", "💬", "📞", "🔔"]

solutionEmojis.label: After emojis
solutionEmojis.description: JSON array of emojis for the calm / after state (3-5 types, cycled to fill 16 slots distributed around the central text). Example: ["✨", "📋", "✅", "🎯"]

textColor.label: Text color
textColor.description: Override text color (leave empty for auto).
